notes.title: Pixeljam's Dino Run 2 Kickstarter Campaign
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p][/p][p]Pixeljam has always worked on multiple projects at once (with different teams), and the thing we've probably spent the most time on is a sequel to our 2008 browser game [b]Dino Run.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8046540/5d81a15e7389bb67a1a0aad4d73cec0ae03f0fec.png"][/img][/p][p]It's pixel-art prehistoric multiplayer platformer with world-building tools included to let people create and share their own experiences.[/p][p]We've been either dreaming, planning, developing or crowdfunding on it since 2012 or so. We finally have enough momentum to make a final push to get to Early Access release on Steam, and if you are curious about it, please [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8" style="button"]click here to check out the Kickstarter Campaign[/url] we just launched.[/p][p][/p][p]Everyone that backs it will get immediate access to the current [b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b], where you can explore & experiment, design & destroy, hang out and have fun alone or with friends:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8046540/3f1c7e23b2f891a3e5051580a3045158574ade27.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p]

notes.title: Pixeljam's Upcoming Games!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

It's a good time to let folks know what Pixeljam's been up to in the past few years, and what's coming up as well...

We just announced our latest game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412540/Operation_Zero/]OPERATION ZERO[/url], a top-down run-n-gun with a sci-fi comedy edge.  Please consider giving it a wishlist:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28377598/e58fc634a3a48bc9303a7b4088df6ea7a0ea53ec.gif[/img]


We also just updated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2964400/Grid_Ranger/]GRID RANGER[/url], a shortform fast-paced shmup-like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28377598/909f137ef13fcc9adf27946e1040cdf4d5d1a360.gif[/img]


We'll also be making a major update soon to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849680/Utopia_Must_Fall/]UTOPIA MUST FALL[/url], a base-defending arcade shooter:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28377598/e1d73b142b1e77442f0c21c103fb915da9ea5a7c.gif[/img]

And of course we're always working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590330/Dino_Run_2/]DINO RUN 2[/url], which should release sometime in 2025 as well.

Take care,

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: Pixeljam's Upcoming Dino Run 2!
notes.notes:
Hello All,

You may or may not know that we made a browser game 15 years ago called [b]Dino Run[/b]. 

We are finally making a sequel and have a coming soon page for it now.  Please wishlist it if it interests you:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590330/Dino_Run_2/

It's a multiplayer prehistoric platformer / runner with a lot of visual customizations & user-made levels. You can keep up with its development via our [url=https://discord.gg/JM2MMUf]Discord[/url] server and also on [url=https://pixeljam.com/dinorun]pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url].

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10209198/f12ea75201dc7c2b9e61c7e12e87ab3e47c9514e.png[/img]

notes.title: The PIXELJAM COMPLETE Megabundle + DLC Supporter Packs Are Live
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Yesterday we launched [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], a massive collection that brings together 14 years of our creative output in a single bundle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6883465/52afdd3b33033872257b632aab4595fb34aa93bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 20+ games & soundtracks
[*] Prototypes & alphas from projects we never finished
[*] Wallpapers, design sketches, art, gifs, comics, music & more
[/list]

[b]You can find it here: [url=https://pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete]pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete[/url][/b]

In tandem with this bundle, we are also rolling out "supporter packs" for each of our games on Steam, that contain sketches, concept art, gifs, wallpapers & soundtracks:

(click each game for its supporter pack)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159130/Cheap_Golf_SUSAN_Supporter_Pack/]Cheap Golf[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/335170/Potatoman_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Potatoman Seeks The Troof[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Glorkian Warrior[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Last Horizon[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/510800/Dino_Run_DX_OST/]Dino Run DX[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Gamma Bros[/url] (Launches Oct 21)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160350/Snowball_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Snowball![/url] (Launches Oct 21)

If you just want the goodies for 1 or 2 of our games, the Steam DLC's are the way to go.  However, each of them are only about 1% of the total contents of the Pixeljam Complete bundle, which is overall a much better value.

Also, if you'd like to help boost our launch signal, [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames/status/1184125853371949056]click here[/url].

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: Huge DLC Expansion + Upcoming Mega-Bundle
notes.notes:
We just upgraded the existing DLC to include a lot more than just the Soundtrack - if you look in the [b]Goodies[/b] folder under the games's local files, you'll find a treasure trove of game-related artwork, wallpapers, comics & painting by James Kochalka.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8046540/6f0194bb91aed88b647e7aa22fc0349cb4a7545c.jpg[/img]

If you own the DLC, it should be updated already.  If you don't, it's 50% off this week:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/[/url]


This expansion is in preparation for the the mega-bundle we are preparing to launch next week, called [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], which will include every game we've made (over 20!) , some completed but unreleased games, every soundtrack, prototypes & alphas, concept art, design docs, gifs, wallpapers, etc...  over 1800 files spanning our 14 years of making games.  

[b]Sign up for our mailing list at [url=http://bit.ly/pixeljammail]http://bit.ly/pixeljammail[/url] to be notified when it launches![/b]. Also, follow us on Twitter for tons of bundle-related festivities: [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames]https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames[/url].

notes.title: Dino Run Has Launched On Steam!
notes.notes:
[url=store.steampowered.com/app/248330/]http://store.steampowered.com/app/248330/[/url]

We made this game long before Glorkian Warrior, but recently shaped it up for a proper Steam release.

Improvements:
-Multiplayer level cap raised from 10 to 20, with 10 new hairstyles
-Race limit raised from 4 to 6
-True fullscreen mode
-Controller Support
-Achievements and Leaderboards
-New backgrounds and extra layer of polish.
-A few surprises :)

All existing SE owners get a free Steam Key, just email us at pixeljamgames@gmail.com with proof of ownership.

We're also crowdfunding improvements to the game here: [url=http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun] http://www.pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url]. Next updates to the game are [b]level sharing[/b] and [b]multiplayer free run mode[/b].

Help us promote the Steam release!
[url=https://twitter.com/doomsurf/status/648908984108367872]https://twitter.com/doomsurf/status/648908984108367872[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/pixeljamgames/posts/1034015649950334]https://www.facebook.com/pixeljamgames/posts/1034015649950334[/url]

KEEP ON RUNNIN!
-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: We're Crowdfunding For Dino Run, DIY Style
notes.notes:
Hello all,

For those of you that play our other games, you may have heard about Dino Run.  It's probably our most popular game, and today we launched something pretty big for it:

[url=pixeljam.com/dinorun]http://pixeljam.com/dinorun[/url]

We created our own crowdfunding platform to make some major improvements to it.

Dino Run SE is going to be retired, replaced by Dino Run DX.  Anyone who owns the current game (SE) will get a free upgrade to DX, and of course a free Steam Key when we release it on Steam.

Estimated Steam launch:  late September, about a month from now.

More details on the site.

If you want to help us out, please contribute or retweet this:

[url=https://twitter.com/doomsurf/status/634461633297948672]https://twitter.com/doomsurf/status/634461633297948672[/url]

Thanks for reading!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: We've just launched a MAJOR UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello Glorkian Warriors (and normal humans),

We just launched a major update to the game, adding the following things:

- 2 New Invaders - Fwoggy and Angrox
- 1 New Weapon : Flamethrower!
- 1 New Environment: The Glorkian Homeworld
We also added a new difficulty mode: ACE, for expert players.  It also adds a new leaderboard type of the same name.

Other tweaks:
- We added a link to global leaderboards from within the game
- We added a new ground character: Squishees.  They bounce you pretty high, so be careful with them.

We hope everyone enjoys the new stuff!

-Miles & The Pixeljam Team
